title: Latent versus text coordination for code executing agents
dek: Can analysis agents coordinate by sharing hidden states instead of talking in text? Mostly yes, until the chain gets long.

title: Exogenous Sensorimotor Imprint
dek: A third question to sit beside empowerment and homeostasis: how much of an agent's future is being written by sources it cannot steer?
note: An early theoretical note. Not fully formalized yet, and openly so.

title: Speculative Decoding for Contact-Aware Robotics
dek: Judging a vision and touch reconstruction by how it behaves under a grasp, not by how closely it matches the average shape.
note: An early research note, still taking shape.

title: Alvalta: an art project
dek: Three equations meeting in a dark square.

title: Music for language models: mood tokens for hidden computation
dek: Training a small family of control tokens that steer not how much a model thinks, but how it thinks.

title: MedFiber: replicating fibres to train better models
dek: Generating synthetic 3D fibre volumes with exact labels, so a segmenter can learn from data no one had to label by hand.

title: Arthantar: better translation without bigger models
dek: My bachelor thesis asked whether a smaller translation model could beat larger ones without retraining by surrounding it with the right framework.
